description: Make the app deployable as two Node.js Lambdas built from this repo (plan D2/D3/D4/D9, item 1): an API Lambda running the existing Hono app via hono/aws-lambda with an async upload path (S3 input + SQS + EventBridge, 202), and an SQS worker Lambda running runPipeline with the AWS bundle. Also fixes AwsTraceStore.getDocument (versions/decisions were never merged, so GET draft would 404 on AWS), adds a DynamoDB-backed search fallback for when OpenSearch is disabled, SigV4-signs OpenSearch, records the Cognito actor on decisions, and adds the cross-platform bun build script. The local path (AIDLC_PROVIDER=local, sync upload 201) must stay unchanged. First feature; FEAT-006/007 depend on its names.
steps: src/server/errors.ts: add 202 to the HttpStatus union.

src/domain/types.ts: add optional `recordedBy?: string` to Decision. src/providers/interfaces.ts: add optional `recordedBy?: string` to DecisionInput. src/providers/local/local-trace-store.ts recordDecision: copy input.recordedBy onto the decision when present (omit the key otherwise).

src/server/routes.ts: export `interface RouteOptions { submitUpload?: (input: { filename: string; text?: string; contentBase64?: string; metadata?: { entidad?: string; procesoId?: string } }) => Promise<{ documentId: string; status: DocumentStatus }>; resolveActor?: (c: Context) => string | undefined; onEvent?: (detailType: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>; authMode?: 'none' | 'cognito' }`. Change the signature to `registerRoutes(app, getBundle, options: RouteOptions = {})`. Extract the upload handler into one function mounted on BOTH `POST /documents/upload` and `POST /documents` (template parity). When options.submitUpload is set, call it after validation and return c.json({documentId, status}, 202), otherwise keep today's synchronous runPipeline 201 response byte-for-byte. Decision route: pass `recordedBy: options.resolveActor?.(c)` to recordDecision, then `await options.onEvent?.('DecisionRecorded', {documentId, decisionId, findingId, action})` inside try/catch; on failure call logError('POST /documents/:id/decision onEvent', err) and still return 200. /health returns `{ status: 'ok', auth: options.authMode ?? 'none' }`.
src/server/app.ts: extend BuildAppOptions with `routes?: RouteOptions` and pass it to registerRoutes. No behavior change when absent.

src/providers/aws/aws-trace-store.ts: constructor(config, client?: Pick<DynamoDBClient,'send'>) using the injected client when given. getDocument: after reading METADATA, set `record.versions = await this.listVersions(id)` (sorted by version asc) and `record.decisions = await this.listDecisions(id)` (sorted by recordedAt asc). recordDecision: when input.recordedBy is set, store `recordedBy`, `GSI1PK = USER#<sub>`, `GSI1SK = recordedAt` attributes (template DecisionRecorder parity). Update the header comment: replace the 'CloudFormation Lambdas' wording with 'the single-table design documented in infra/terraform/modules/storage'.

Create src/providers/aws/aws-dynamo-search-index.ts: `export class DynamoFindingsSearchIndex implements SearchIndex` with constructor(config, client?). index(): documented no-op (findings are already projected into the findings table by AwsTraceStore.saveDocument). search(q): paginated ScanCommand over settings.findingsTable (ExclusiveStartKey loop) wrapped in callService, parse each item's `data` JSON as Finding (skip malformed items with a counted warning, never throw on one bad row), group by documentId, index into a fresh `new LocalSearchIndex()` and return its search(q).

src/providers/aws/aws-search-index.ts: build the client with SigV4: `import { AwsSigv4Signer } from '@opensearch-project/opensearch/aws-v3'` and `import { defaultProvider } from '@aws-sdk/credential-provider-node'`; `new Client({ ...AwsSigv4Signer({ region: settings.region, service: 'es', getCredentials: () => defaultProvider()() }), node: endpoint })`. Remove the SigV4 FUTURE WIRING note. If the aws-v3 subpath does not type-check under moduleResolution bundler, fall back to '@opensearch-project/opensearch/aws' and record it in findings.

src/providers/aws/aws-common.ts: add `searchBackend: 'dynamodb' | 'opensearch'` to AwsSettings, read from env.AWS_SEARCH_BACKEND ('opensearch' only when explicitly set; otherwise 'dynamodb'). Change both Bedrock model defaults to 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'. Replace the 'CloudFormation defaults in iac/template.yaml (eliminado; reemplazado por infra/terraform/)' comment with 'defaults match the Terraform names in infra/terraform'. src/providers/aws/index.ts: searchIndex = settings.searchBackend === 'opensearch' ? new AwsSearchIndex(config) : new DynamoFindingsSearchIndex(config). src/config.ts: AWS region default 'us-east-2'.

Create src/lambda/types.ts with minimal local types (no @types/aws-lambda): SqsRecord {messageId, body, attributes: {ApproximateReceiveCount: string}}, SqsEvent {Records: SqsRecord[]}, SqsBatchResponse {batchItemFailures: {itemIdentifier: string}[]}.

Create src/lambda/aws-queue.ts (`interface UploadQueue { send(message: {documentId: string; inputKey: string}): Promise<void> }`, `class SqsUploadQueue` using @aws-sdk/client-sqs SendMessageCommand with requireConfig(AGILIA_QUEUE_URL)) and src/lambda/aws-events.ts (`interface EventPublisher { publish(detailType: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> }`, `class EventBridgePublisher` using @aws-sdk/client-eventbridge PutEventsCommand on AGILIA_EVENT_BUS_NAME with source 'agilia.documents'; throw AwsProviderError when FailedEntryCount > 0). Both go through callService.

Create src/lambda/submit-upload.ts: `createSubmitUpload({ providers, queue, events })` returns the RouteOptions.submitUpload function. It does: documentId = randomUUID(); inputKey = `uploads/${documentId}/input.json`; storage.put(inputKey, JSON.stringify(input)); traceStore.saveDocument({documentId, status:'RECEIVED', filename, findings:[], alerts:[], versions:[], decisions:[], createdAt, updatedAt}); queue.send({documentId, inputKey}); events.publish('DocumentUploaded', {documentId}). Return {documentId, status:'RECEIVED'}. Each step's errors propagate (the route turns them into a 500 via guard).

Create src/lambda/api.ts: `export function createApiHandler(deps: { providers: ProviderBundle; submitUpload?: RouteOptions['submitUpload']; onEvent?: RouteOptions['onEvent'] })` returns `handle(buildApp({ providers, routes: { submitUpload, onEvent, authMode: 'cognito', resolveActor: (c) => c.env?.event?.requestContext?.authorizer?.claims?.sub } }))` from 'hono/aws-lambda' (type the env access defensively). Export `handler`, built lazily on first invocation from `loadConfig(process.env)` + `buildAwsProviders(config)` (import from '../providers/aws/index.ts' DIRECTLY, never getProviders) + SqsUploadQueue + EventBridgePublisher. Lazy construction keeps imports side-effect free for tests and the bundle verifier.

Create src/lambda/worker.ts: `export function createWorkerHandler(deps: { providers: ProviderBundle; events: EventPublisher; maxReceiveCount: number })` returns `async (event: SqsEvent): Promise<SqsBatchResponse>`. Per record: parse the body ({documentId, inputKey}; invalid JSON or missing fields => log and report a batch failure), read storage.get(inputKey) (null => failure), parse it as the upload input, `await runPipeline({ ...input, documentId }, providers)`, then events.publish('DraftReady', {documentId, version}). On any error: console.error with the redacted context (redactForLog; never log document text). If Number(record.attributes.ApproximateReceiveCount) >= maxReceiveCount, mark the document ERROR (getDocument then saveDocument with status 'ERROR') and publish 'ProcessingFailed', with the errors of these secondary calls logged. Always push {itemIdentifier: messageId} for failed records. Export a lazy `handler` from env (AGILIA_MAX_RECEIVE_COUNT default 3).

Create scripts/build-lambda.ts: for entries {api: 'src/lambda/api.ts', worker: 'src/lambda/worker.ts'}, rm -rf dist/lambda/<name> (node:fs/promises rm recursive force), then `await Bun.build({ entrypoints: [abs entry], outdir: dist/lambda/<name>, target: 'node', format: 'esm', minify: true, sourcemap: 'none', naming: 'index.mjs', banner: 'import { createRequire as __agiliaCreateRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __agiliaCreateRequire(import.meta.url);' })`. If !result.success, print result.logs and process.exit(1). Print each output path and size in KB. Resolve paths from import.meta.url so it works from any cwd on Windows and bash.

Create scripts/verify-lambda-bundle.ts: set fake env (AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws, AWS_REGION=us-east-2, AWS_S3_BUCKET=verify-bucket, AWS_DYNAMODB_TRACEABILITY_TABLE, AWS_DYNAMODB_FINDINGS_TABLE, AGILIA_QUEUE_URL=https://sqs.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/000000000000/verify, AGILIA_EVENT_BUS_NAME=verify, AWS_SEARCH_BACKEND=dynamodb, and fake AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY so SDK construction never looks up a profile). Then dynamic-import pathToFileURL(dist/lambda/api/index.mjs) and call handler with a minimal API Gateway REST v1 event for GET /health (httpMethod, path, resource, headers, multiValueHeaders, queryStringParameters null, requestContext {stage:'dev', path:'/dev/health', httpMethod:'GET', requestId, identity:{sourceIp}}, body null, isBase64Encoded false). Assert statusCode 200 and that the body contains "auth":"cognito". Import the worker bundle and assert typeof handler === 'function'. Exit 1 with a clear message if a bundle is missing ('ejecute bun run build:lambda').

package.json: add scripts `"build:lambda": "bun run scripts/build-lambda.ts"` and `"verify:lambda": "bun run scripts/verify-lambda-bundle.ts"`; add dependencies `@aws-sdk/client-sqs`, `@aws-sdk/client-eventbridge`, `@aws-sdk/credential-provider-node` (all ^3.700.0). Run `bun install` (cwd = worktree) and keep the bun.lock changes.

.env.example: rewrite in UTF-8 (fix the mojibake dashes). Set AWS_REGION=us-east-2. Add, with comments, AWS_DYNAMODB_TRACEABILITY_TABLE=agilia-traceability-dev, AWS_DYNAMODB_FINDINGS_TABLE=agilia-findings-dev, AWS_BEDROCK_RULE_MODEL_ID / AWS_BEDROCK_DRAFT_MODEL_ID=us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 (marked 'confirmar acceso en la cuenta'), AWS_COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE=es, AWS_SEARCH_BACKEND=dynamodb, AGILIA_QUEUE_URL=, AGILIA_EVENT_BUS_NAME=. Keep AIDLC_PROVIDER=local as the default and keep the existing keys.

Tests (bun:test, temp dirs under <worktree>/.data/test-*, removed in afterAll): tests/lambda/api-handler.test.ts builds createApiHandler with isolated local providers, a fake queue/events recording calls and a fake submitUpload built from createSubmitUpload. Cover: GET /health event => 200 auth 'cognito'; POST /documents/upload => 202 RECEIVED, queue got {documentId, inputKey}, storage has the input; POST /documents alias => 202; invalid upload body => 400; decision with requestContext.authorizer.claims.sub='user-123' => persisted decision.recordedBy === 'user-123'. tests/lambda/worker.test.ts: success => record DRAFTED with >= 1 version and DraftReady published; missing input key => batchItemFailures contains the messageId; failure with ApproximateReceiveCount '3' => status ERROR + ProcessingFailed; malformed body => failure. tests/providers/aws-trace-store.test.ts: a fake client whose send() answers GetItemCommand/QueryCommand by command.constructor.name. Assert getDocument returns the merged versions + decisions, that a missing item returns null, and that a service error surfaces as AwsProviderError. tests/providers/aws-dynamo-search-index.test.ts: a fake paginated Scan (2 pages) returns ranked results for a matching term, an empty array for no match, and a malformed row is skipped.
acceptance_criteria: `bun test` reports 0 failures and more than 44 passing tests (all old tests unchanged and green).
`bun run build:lambda` produces dist/lambda/api/index.mjs and dist/lambda/worker/index.mjs and exits 0.
`bun run verify:lambda` exits 0 after invoking the bundled API handler for GET /health (statusCode 200, auth cognito).
With no options, buildApp() behaves exactly as before: POST /documents/upload returns 201 synchronously (existing server test proves it).
No new code hardcodes credentials; SDK errors are wrapped and logged, never swallowed.

ENV VARS ACTUALLY READ by the Lambdas: AIDLC_PROVIDER (loadConfig; Lambda entries call buildAwsProviders directly so it is informational there but Terraform should still set aws), AWS_REGION (Lambda reserved; default us-east-2), AWS_S3_BUCKET (required by AwsStorage), AWS_DYNAMODB_TRACEABILITY_TABLE, AWS_DYNAMODB_FINDINGS_TABLE, AWS_BEDROCK_RULE_MODEL_ID, AWS_BEDROCK_DRAFT_MODEL_ID, AWS_COMPREHEND_LANGUAGE, AWS_SEARCH_BACKEND ('opensearch' only when exactly that value, else dynamodb), AWS_OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT (required only when opensearch), AGILIA_QUEUE_URL (required by API Lambda only), AGILIA_EVENT_BUS_NAME (required by both), AGILIA_MAX_RECEIVE_COUNT (worker; positive int, default 3). AGILIA_AUTH_MODE is NOT read: the API Lambda hardcodes authMode 'cognito' (setting it in Terraform is harmless). Legacy AWS_DYNAMODB_DOCUMENTS_TABLE still overrides the traceability table if set; Terraform must not set it.

IAM-RELEVANT CALLS: api role -> s3:PutObject uploads/*, s3:GetObject drafts/* (GET draft), dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem/Query on traceability, dynamodb:Scan on findings (search, dynamodb backend), sqs:SendMessage on processing queue, events:PutEvents on bus. worker role -> s3:GetObject uploads/*, s3:PutObject nlp/* and drafts/*, dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem/Query traceability, dynamodb:PutItem findings, textract/comprehend/bedrock:InvokeModel as before, events:PutEvents, plus SQS consume (ReceiveMessage/DeleteMessage/GetQueueAttributes) via the event source mapping. OpenSearch backend -> es:ESHttpGet/ESHttpPost/ESHttpPut (client.index uses PUT /<index>/_doc/<id>). Event source mapping MUST set function_response_types=["ReportBatchItemFailures"] (worker returns batchItemFailures).

EVENTS (source agilia.documents): DocumentUploaded {documentId} (API), DecisionRecorded {documentId,decisionId,findingId,action} (API), DraftReady {documentId,version} (worker), ProcessingFailed {documentId,reason} (worker, only when ApproximateReceiveCount >= AGILIA_MAX_RECEIVE_COUNT). Async upload response: 202 {documentId, status:'RECEIVED'}; SPA must poll GET /documents/{id} until DRAFTED or ERROR.

DEVIATIONS: (1) OpenSearch signer import '@opensearch-project/opensearch/aws-v3' type-checks and bundles; no fallback needed. (2) AwsTraceStore.queryByPrefix now paginates (LastEvaluatedKey loop) so getDocument never truncates versions/decisions. (3) Worker re-validates the stored upload input with parseUploadBody (zod) before running the pipeline; an invalid input is a batch failure. (4) When the document record is missing on the last delivery, markFailed saves a minimal ERROR record instead of skipping. (5) verify script uses fake creds 'verify-only-fake-access-key' (not AKIA-shaped, to avoid secret scanners). (6) Hono's hono/aws-lambda is marked deprecated in 4.13 (moves to @hono/aws-lambda in v5); still used per plan, works. (7) Extra tests beyond the plan: onEvent failure still 200, queue failure -> 500 without leaking detail, decision without authorizer omits recordedBy, mixed batch partial failure, readMaxReceiveCount fallback, Scan failure -> AwsProviderError, corrupt METADATA -> AwsProviderError, recordDecision GSI1 keys present/absent. (8) app.ts WEB_DIR resolves to dist/web/ inside the bundle (does not exist) so '/', '/index.html', '/app.js' return 404 on Lambda; the SPA is served by CloudFront/S3 (D6), API routes are unaffected.

OBSERVATION (no change, not a break): neither role has s3:ListBucket, so a GetObject on a missing key returns 403 AccessDenied instead of 404 NoSuchKey; AwsStorage.get then throws AwsProviderError instead of returning null. Effects: the worker reports a batch failure either way (same retry/DLQ path); GET /documents/{id}/draft would answer 500 instead of 404 only if a version record points at a deleted blob, which the pipeline never produces (it writes the blob before addVersion). Adding s3:ListBucket would widen the roles to list the whole bucket, so it was left out. ITERATION 2 FIXES (review R1, R3, R4, R5). R1: src/pipeline/pipeline.ts now saves the record as VALIDATED first and saves DRAFTED last, after the draft blob, addVersion and searchIndex.index, carrying listVersions() so LocalTraceStore keeps its versions. Readers polling for DRAFTED can no longer hit 404 on /draft; a failed persist leaves VALIDATED (markFailed later sets ERROR). Local sync route still returns the DRAFTED record (201). New tests in tests/pipeline/pipeline.integration.test.ts: status read at addVersion is VALIDATED and DRAFTED is saved with 1 version; a drafts/ put failure leaves VALIDATED with no versions. R3: src/lambda/worker.ts skips a message whose document is already DRAFTED with >= 1 version (no Bedrock rerun, no version 2, no ERROR on the 3rd receive) and logs instead of failing when DraftReady cannot be published. R4: src/lambda/submit-upload.ts logs a failed DocumentUploaded publish via logError and still returns RECEIVED (202), because the SQS message is already sent. New tests in tests/lambda/worker.test.ts cover R3 (publish failure keeps DRAFTED with 1 version and no batch failure; redelivery with receiveCount 3 is skipped) and R4. R5: the earlier observation is superseded; see FEAT-007 (s3:ListBucket scoped by s3:prefix).
